title: 贝莱德Agon：印度被贴反AI标签，IT人才池能否转身？
speaker: Agon Favric

segments.en: For many investor perspective, today India is probably still receiving a labeling of anti-AI exposure which I think we don't have too much, simply I think India has many very interesting fundamental drivers which can carry the markets so I think we still interesting and constructive on the regional long-term.
segments.zh: 从许多投资者角度看，今天印度可能仍被贴上反AI敞口的标签，我们认为这不太成立，印度有许多非常有趣的基本面驱动力可以支撑市场，所以我们对区域长期仍感兴趣且建设性。

segments.en: I think the bigger issue for us that if you look at IT service sector in India as a huge employment pool and a huge talent pool as well, if you believe that all of this AI agent will need to have an enterprise version where those individuals able to design a product running for clients and so on, I think it's a really high likelihood that those individuals can be retrained and can be avoidable partner for many years to come.
segments.zh: 我们认为更大的问题是，如果把印度IT服务部门看作巨大的就业池和人才池，如果你相信所有这些AI代理都需要企业版本，需要这些人设计面向客户的产品，那么这些人很有可能可以再培训，并在未来多年成为可依赖的伙伴。

segments.en: It's been a while since we've had a US 10-year yield at 5%, it's been what, let's call it 17, 19 years now.
segments.zh: 美国10年期收益率达到5%已经有一段时间没见了，大概有17、19年了。

segments.en: How do you think EMs as a whole, and now we have AI, we've never had AI, how does that hold up against that macro backdrop of higher rates?
segments.zh: 你认为新兴市场整体，现在还有AI，我们从未有过AI，在更高利率的宏观背景下会如何表现？

segments.en: Definitely something we have to spend more time today, so if it looks really easy voyation metrics as well, when you have to use a steeper discount rate to value your earnings power and free cash flow, that clearly going to have an impact on our voyation.
segments.zh: 这确实是我们今天要花更多时间讨论的，如果估值指标看起来很容易，当你必须用更高的贴现率来评估盈利能力和自由现金流时，这显然会对估值产生影响。

segments.en: The positive news that being part of the fundamental equity team, we actually try to find unique businesses who can compound on multi-year horizon and be that labeling, that policy rate repricing can be a headwind but cannot define reality.
segments.zh: 好消息是，作为基本面权益团队，我们实际上试图寻找能在多年维度上复利的独特企业，政策利率重定价可能是逆风，但不能定义现实。

segments.en: So that's also what we're seeing, that view resonant of that, and I think it's going to make a bigger impact top-down, and probably for some of the regions and asset classes, but if you're able to run the really well constructed narrow portfolio, I think we have a capacity to over on that possible headwind coming through from higher policy rate, not only in the US, but also globally.
segments.zh: 这也是我们看到的，这种观点引起共鸣，我认为它会在自上而下层面产生更大影响，可能对某些地区和资产类别如此，但如果你能运行构建良好的窄组合，我认为我们有能力克服来自更高政策利率的可能逆风，不仅在美国，也在全球。
